summary: The Access map shows a group's real path, and you can change many rows in one step.

new.title: Filter Access map columns
new.text: Filter each column by All, Assigned or Not assigned to find your way through hundreds of groups.

new.title: Change many rows at once
new.text: Select rows in a delegation table and set Policy, Duration, Type or Auto-extend for all of them in one step.

fixes.title: Access map shows the path
fixes.text: Selecting a group now shows its real path with the lines. Possible link targets appear only while you drag or when you switch them on.
